name: Ginrin Cycle
description: A restrained, technical store theme for a small workshop that builds steel bicycles by hand and sells frames, wheels and quiet accessories, with a repair service: steel-mist pages, paper panels and graphite text with a single burnt-orange accent kept to small marks, Rubik in light weights with tight tracking and IBM Plex Mono for spec lines and prices; a header laid out like the title block of an engineering drawing, the menu as a row of hairline-ruled cells with the account and basket in the last cells, a product-first home page whose grid shares its hairlines like a drawing sheet, the build process, the repair price list and the journal, a spoke-wheel mark used as the divider and the loading indicator (still for visitors who ask for less motion), and a split two-tone footer with the graphite workshop card beside a steel panel for the newsletter and links; with custom builds and a gallery, a repair service page, about, a journal, a monthly letter and contact, the workshop address and hours, the repair prices and the product grid kept in three synced patterns so each is edited once, a dark Night Shift style variation, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.
deviation: Planned as Rubik Mono One + Rubik with #FF6A13 in a sporty, technical look. Changed at the user's request (elegant, restrained Japanese minimal, no bright colours, no sporty or street-poster look): the accent is toned down to burnt orange #B4532A and kept to small marks, rules, the sale tag and the loader; Rubik Mono One is replaced by Rubik in light and medium weights with IBM Plex Mono for spec lines and prices; style tags are minimal + technical instead of sporty + technical. Header, footer and layout codes are as planned (H6, F10, L11).

fonts.role: headings at light weight with tight tracking, body text, navigation and buttons
spec lines, prices, labels, index numbers, captions and the workshop card
fonts.copyright: Copyright 2017 IBM Corp. with Reserved Font Name "Plex"

store.withoutPlugin: The shop page lists every frame, wheel and accessory with its photograph, spec line and price, and orders go by phone or email; store templates are not used.
